content: Sigwey, ivag sivinem bukukwakins daGuyaws nakabsunap. Mtowen Yeisuw Kelis beiyum beim, mo bitakatuyouns bitanekes.

Igaw bukuliganes gamag mwasanin askamikon, o asilivan mamagina, “DaGuyaws nakabsunap tut towen waseg.” Awoum ge bikubukub nuwamiy, o beiyow nuwamiy; awoum. O kukin gamag mwasanin bilivans, bilansa, “Pawl nalet waseg ilel, idoki daGuyaws nakabsunap tut towen waseg,” awoum bikubukub nuwamiy, peinan tayyaweids tasiyas.

Awoum teitan gamag bikatidavimiy. Kadiloka bukukwakins gamag babaw wanmugwana bipiyaves Yowbad nakaleiwag, wankuyeim mo bisap Yeisuw. Towen tasiplavein Yowbad nakaleiwag bisap wanamug; tage Yeisuw wankuyeim. Dadub gimgeilin towen, peinan takamna̱mwan towen, biyyagay yowbad babaw o Geileiw babaw, bikamumwan tatonen mo bisin Yowbad wanbunatum, bilana, ‘Yey Yowbad yey.’
Kweiboug sigwey yakamiy nitasesus mo adibakeimiy ma̱wan. Tabta kunuwes?
Kadiloka kunuways aveiyag waseg isilbwed towen takamna̱mwan, peinan tutan bikadilok mo bisap.

Nakawotet kalbaleb nagein nises ven watinow, o nag bitakakins silawun. Tayuwein gog, isilbwed takamna̱mwan towen, bisilbwadena oko igaw mo bein tana̱ban, tasiplavein gog kaleiwag mo bisap, o gamag babaw bikines; tage daGuyaws Yeisuw bisap son nakamnat avakaein, mo beiweiy taw towen wadon muymuyan waseg.

Seitan nileb mtowen takamna̱mwan, tayyaweid towen, im iwtel naman mulin babaw-wan tawtoun, va̱gan bikatidavis gamag mwasanin, mo bimta̱mats; peinan nag sivines sinap mounid, mata ge Yowbad bikatinabwes.
Mapuna Yowbad niyabol ninous va̱gan kid bisimounids sinap yaweid waseg, mo bimop asisinap tasiyas babaw tapiyaveins sinap mounid, peinan sivines kid sinap kalbaleb.

Sigwey, daGuyaws angamag yakamiy, yakamey tut babaw ikadilokena bikalin nuwem Yowbad waseg, peinan tut nakabsilamaw waseg nikatigikeimiy va̱gan kid bikatinabweimiy. Kululuwan gog waseg nikayuseimiy va̱gan kid bukuliganes anilivan mounid.
Livan towen, liva̱nen Yeisuw Kelis, nakadibakeimiy mo kuliganes va̱gan daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis nakamnat waseg bimteilimiy; peinan Yowbad nanon ma̱wan.
E sigwey, kadiloka bukutamanaws sona mitawtoun, bukuyousis beibwein livan towen nakasekeimiy, wudom waseg nakadibakeimiy, o malet-vak niwekeimiy.

Tamads Yowbad singay isiwyoubuds, ikimtuweids va̱gan tut babaw nanouds beibwein peinan taninuways aveiyag bwanabwein bisekeids tut wanakougwaw. Tamads towen son daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis bikimtuweimiy va̱gan bukuninatouts, bukuwotets wotet babaw bwanabwein son amilivan bwanabwein.
